title: 500 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaTitle: 500 Hour Yoga Teacher Training in Bali
metaDescription: This Yoga Alliance USA RYT500 500 hour yoga teacher training course equip you with different aspects of yoga — Asanas with proper alignments and adjustments, pranayama, shatkarmas, meditation, bandhas, anatomy and physiology, yoga philosophy, yoga mantras, and the art of teaching.
summary: This 500 hour yoga teacher training offers you a whole new physical, mental, and spiritual exploration and expansion.
intro: Welcome to Bali Yoga School for our 500 hours Yoga Teacher Training in Bali! In this 58 days 500 hour yoga teacher training course in Bali, you will indulge yourself in the spiritual and culturally rich, tropical island of Bali and enjoy life with the yoga practices with like-minded yogis. This 500 hour yoga teacher training course equips you with different aspects of yoga — Asanas with proper alignments and adjustments, pranayama, shatkarmas, meditation, bandhas, anatomy and physiology, yoga philosophy, yoga mantras, and the art of teaching.
Yoga teacher training course contains all the fundamental aspects to truly understand and be able to live a yogic life. Let us take you on the journey of personal and professional self-development.
durationStatements: In this 58 days 500 hour yoga teacher training course in Bali
44 Training Days + 12 Off Days + Check-in 1 Day before the course + 1 Day for checkout

300-hour part: 24 Training Days + 2 Off Days + Check-in 1 Day before the course + 1 Day for checkout; Total: 28 Days

The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, The course completes on 27th of next month at 5:00 pm with graduation & fire ceremony performed by the graduates & their masters.
Batch dates: 1st of a month to 28th of the next month

mealTimes: (Except for lunch and dinner on Sundays)

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 5:00 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program. The course completes on 27th of next month at 5:00 pm with graduation & fire ceremony performed by the graduates & their masters. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel for Bali is to take a flight to Ngurah Rai International Airport Denpasar Bali. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from Denpasar Bali airport.

Complimentary pick-up service from the DPS (I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport) is included in the course fee. Please provide your flight information once you book it, and we will arrange a pick-up for you.
prerequisites: All students are required to complete the prerequisite assignment prior to their arrival and submit it at the time of check-in. The assignment should be printed and each topic compiled separately into a single file for submission.
A high degree of self-motivation is required for all aspects of the course. The practice and especially the teaching of yoga demand a high degree of self-discipline and purity.
To ensure the success of the program, participants are required to attend all spiritual activities, meditation sessions, lectures and asana classes.

Meat, fish, eggs, black tea, coffee, alcohol, tobacco, drugs and nudity are prohibited during the course as they are counterproductive to the yoga practice. Participants who do not comply with the school rules may be dismissed from the course.

policies.title: Prerequisite Assignment
items: This prerequisite is designed to ensure that all participants of the 300-Hour Yoga Teacher Training Program possess the essential foundational knowledge.
Each topic must be answered in 300–500 words.
The 200-Hour YTT Manual (PDF) has been shared with you for reference and guidance while completing the assignment.
If you are unable to complete the assignment due to limited time before the commencement of the program, we kindly allow submission within the first 10 days of the 300-Hour YTT.

policies.title: Class Attendance
items: All classes are mandatory; only in case of an emergency or illness can one take leave with the respective teacher’s permission. Uninformed leaves won’t be accepted and this will leave a bad impression on the student’s performance.

policies.title: Discipline Rules for Students
items: Smoking and alcohol are strictly prohibited in the school.
If you are fasting on any day, you have to inform the kitchen manager to avoid food waste.
Always maintain discipline, respect teachers and follow all rules. Always be on time; if you are late you will not be permitted to join class.
Before departure return your books, maps or any goods which you borrowed.
Friends or relatives will not be included in accommodation; however, they can stay in school by renting another room.
